title: historicalRecord
responsibility: Normalize historical result identity and outcome while preserving unit IDs and distinguishing cancellation.

inputs.name: historicalIdentity.data
inputs.description: Parsed historical result metadata; prefers explicit task/unit identity and normalizes its status without executing result content.

inputs.name: historicalIdentity.path
inputs.description: Filesystem address to read; JSON and filesystem failures propagate. Historical identity uses only its containing folder as a fallback.

inputs.name: historicalOutcome.status
inputs.description: Historical outcome; pass and pass-prefixed values normalize to pass, cancelled remains cancelled and other or missing statuses become fail.

outputs.name: historicalIdentity
outputs.description: Task and unit identity using explicit result fields before the result directory name.

outputs.name: historicalOutcome
outputs.description: Normalized pass, fail or cancelled lifecycle outcome.
